ghi_chu.mo_ta: The skyline on the right shows plain rectangular slab towers with regular window bands. I can't see the Barbican's distinctive towers, which have triangular-plan shafts and projecting balconies. St Paul's dome is only a tiny, doubtful speck at the centre of the skyline.
ghi_chu.ly_do: The Barbican towers were completed by 1976 and should appear in their own form. These generic slab blocks stand where they would be, so the landmark looks missing or replaced.
